notes:
# Recording while you share your screen, on every Mac {camcorder}
Pressing record while you were presenting could produce a run that sat at
"Nothing is being captured yet" for the whole meeting, and it depended on
which Mac you were on. Zoom takes its meeting window away for the length of
a share, and the app noticed that by recognising Zoom's own share windows
BY NAME -- so a Zoom that puts up a different set of them, another version
or another language, read as not sharing at all. On those Macs nobody was
offered the screen to record, and the run waited for a meeting window that
was never coming back. It asks a question now that needs no names: is there
a window named for the meeting? A share leaves none. A window that is
merely MINIMISED still counts, because Zoom will draw that one again and a
capture can wait for it.

# The free trial's quality reads as chosen {sliders}
Hand a licence back and all three quality cards came back unselected --
including Efficient, the only one a trial can use -- while the recordings
were 720p the whole time. The setting on disk was right; the page was
drawing from its own copy of it, loaded before the licence went and never
brought back into line, because only the numbers the page itself had moved
were refreshed. What that copy spelled was 1080p, a preset a trial may not
choose, so nothing lit.

---

Everything else in this release:

- When a run cannot find a meeting window, the log now names the Zoom
  windows it could see. It is the one fact that was never written down, and
  two rounds of diagnosis went by without it -- on a Mac where the fix
  works, that line is what proves it, and on one where it does not, it is
  the answer.
